title: TEMPO groups and VFR minima
question: Per hour ahead (outlook): is below_all / airports larger than below_prev / airports, and how many METARs below the minima sit inside a TEMPO/PROB (consistency.fit)?

issues.text: One snapshot of TAFs and METARs: one weather situation (a November snow day), not a climate of forecasts.
issues.fix: Save the answers every hour for weeks and repeat; NOAA keeps METARs and TAFs for 15 days (hours= and date= parameters).

issues.text: A TEMPO says conditions occur for under half of its period, not all of it; counting every TEMPO hour as below is the planning view, not a probability.
issues.fix: Weight PROB30/40 by their probability, TEMPO by 0.5, and compare with METAR verification.

issues.text: Small airports' TAFs last 9 h, so the population shrinks from about 52 to 14 airports after 9 h.
issues.fix: Compare only the airports with 24/30 h TAFs across all hours.

alternatives.question: How often does a METAR fall outside its own TAF (an amendment due) per airport over a month?
alternatives.why: Drills into TAF verification at one airport.

alternatives.question: Does SMHI's model ceiling between the airports fall below 1500 ft when the TAFs on both ends are VMC?
alternatives.why: Expands to the route between the aerodromes, where no TAF looks.

hypotheses.statement: The share of airports below the VMC minima is higher with every TAF group counted than with the prevailing forecast only.
hypotheses.null: Temporary groups add nothing: the two shares are equal.

hypotheses.statement: The share of airports below the minima by everything the TAF allows falls with the hours ahead (the snow moves out), faster than the prevailing share.

concepts.label: Airport-hour
concepts.description: One airport's TAF in one hour (taf_hours).

concepts.label: Prevailing forecast
concepts.description: BASE, FM or BECMG group valid then.

concepts.label: Temporary group
concepts.description: TEMPO or PROB30/40 valid then, missing elements from the prevailing group.

concepts.label: METAR fit
concepts.description: Inside the prevailing forecast, inside a TEMPO/PROB, or worse than the TAF.

links.note: consistency joins the METAR to its TAF's first hour.

method.summary: Below-minima counts per hour ahead over the airports with a TAF then, prevailing against all groups.

steps.title: Every TAF and METAR in the box
Grade each airport-hour twice
steps.detail: taf_hours: ok_prev and ok_all against 1500 ft / 5 km.

steps.title: Read the gap
steps.detail: Rate ratio and the METAR diamond on the chart.

caveats: TEMPO counted as fully below for planning.
